Which of the following best describes the temperature dependence of electrical conductivity in an intrinsic semiconductor compared to a metallic conductor?
options: Conductivity increases exponentially with temperature in semiconductors, but decreases in metals due to increased electron-phonon scattering.
Conductivity decreases with temperature in semiconductors due to carrier trapping, but increases in metals due to thermal excitation across the Fermi level.
Both exhibit an exponential increase in conductivity with increasing temperature due to the thermal generation of charge carriers.
Both exhibit a decrease in conductivity with increasing temperature due to lattice vibrations interfering with electron mobility.
